stem: Three of the following words relate to each other in one specific way. Find the word that does NOT belong: Mango, Apple, Carrot, Orange.

per_option_rationale.rationale: Mango is a fruit, matching the group property of fruits.
Apple is a fruit, matching the group property of fruits.
Carrot is a vegetable (root vegetable), while Mango, Apple, and Orange are all fruits. Carrot does not share the fruit property, making it the odd one out.
Orange is a fruit, matching the group property of fruits.

explanation: Mango, Apple, and Orange are all fruits. Carrot is a vegetable. The unifying property of three items is being a fruit; Carrot violates this property and is the odd one out.

explanation_sections.punchline: Three are fruits and one is a root vegetable; Carrot is the outlier.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply clues most-certain-first: classify each item by food category. Mango = fruit, Apple = fruit, Orange = fruit, Carrot = vegetable. Exactly one fails the fruit test.
explanation_sections.lesson: Odd-man-out by category requires testing every member against the group property; the one from a different category is the answer.
explanation_sections.timing: About 20 seconds. No arithmetic needed. The trap is selecting Orange (thinking of its colour similarity to Carrot).
